searchText: <@822908652116639806> how does k deal with bitshifting ints at the smt level? Do you use `int_to_bv` and `bv_to_int`? I see this: https://github.com/runtimeverification/k/blob/master/k-distribution/include/kframework/builtin/domains.md#integer-arithmetic which seems to suggest that `>>Int` is translated to `shrInt` in smt, but I can't find a definition of `shrInt` anywhere?
